name: Ravenous Crocodragon Archethys
card_text:
1 Tuner + 1+ non-Tuners
Gains 500 ATK/DEF for each card in your hand. You can only use each of the following effects of "Ravenous Crocodragon Archethys" once per turn. If this card is Synchro Summoned: You can draw cards equal to the number of non-Tuners used for its Synchro Summon. (Quick Effect): You can discard 2 cards, then target 1 card on the field; destroy it.
